positions.title: Software Development Engineer Intern
positions.description:
• Implemented new account creation system for Amazon Business user accounts to reduce 35k failed API calls, resulting in a smoother customer experience for eProcurement providers trying to integrate with our APIs
• Deployed a scalable DynamoDB table stack utilizing AWS CDK with Java, and developed new React components to enhance customer interactions on the frontend
• Developed RESTful APIs within a Java MVC codebase, enabling storage and retrieval of user account data from the DynamoDB table
• Achieved 95% code coverage by implementing JUnit tests for the backend, and utilizing Jest and React Testing Library to test the frontend components
positions.insights: Skills: Git · Docker · React.js · Amazon Dynamodb · JUnit · API Development · Java · Amazon Web Services (AWS)

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
OCI - Cloud Platforms Security and Application Platform Team
• Utilized TypeScript, React, and Java to modify an internal DevOps tool, streamlining the onboarding and management process for over 15 service teams on Oracle Cloud
• Developed new frontend components using TypeScript and React enabling teams to view the status of their service and make modifications all in one place
• Implemented unit tests using JUnit for the backend and Jest, achieving over 85% code coverage
positions.insights: Skills: Jest · Git · TypeScript · Docker · React.js · JUnit · Java

positions.title: Software Development Intern
positions.description:
• Developed and implemented MongoDB views using MQL to securely extract and display data from over 50,000 customers on Microsoft Power BI dashboards
• Designed and created a Microsoft Power BI dashboard to provide real-time visibility into 20 key project metrics for 5 Lead Technology Officers

positions.title: Web Application Developer
positions.description:
• Developed a new web mapping application from scratch using HTML, CSS, and Javascript to display Public Land Survey System data points
• Utilized Leaflet and Carto.js to design the frontend, and used the Carto SQL API to fetch coordinates for 50,000 data points
• Optimized a mapping application using React Leaflet and the Carto SQL API, resulting in a 70% increase in performance by displaying over 200,000 data points more quickly than the original application
positions.insights: Skills: Git · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · React.js · JavaScript · HTML · SQL
